```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 7, fig.height = 5
)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(knitr)
```

```{r load-data}
## Results from bayes/statespace/*_comparison.R (100 replicates each).
res_dir <- "../bayes"

design <- tibble::tribble(
  ~file,                        ~process, ~random_effect, ~survival,
  "ma_good_det_results.rds",    "MA(1)",  "innovations",  "Deterministic",
  "ma_bad_det_results.rds",     "MA(1)",  "states",       "Deterministic",
  "ma_good_stoch_results.rds",  "MA(1)",  "innovations",  "Stochastic",
  "ma_bad_stoch_results.rds",   "MA(1)",  "states",       "Stochastic",
  "ar_good_det_results.rds",    "AR(1)",  "states",       "Deterministic",
  "ar_bad_det_results.rds",     "AR(1)",  "innovations",  "Deterministic",
  "ar_good_stoch_results.rds",  "AR(1)",  "states",       "Stochastic",
  "ar_bad_stoch_results.rds",   "AR(1)",  "innovations",  "Stochastic"
) |>
  mutate(column = paste(sub("\\(1\\)", "", process), random_effect))

col_order <- c("MA innovations", "MA states", "AR states", "AR innovations")
method_labels <- c(tmb = "RTMB", tmbstan = "tmbstan", stan = "Stan")

results <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(design)), function(k) {
  readRDS(file.path(res_dir, design$file[k])) |>
    mutate(process = design$process[k],
           random_effect = design$random_effect[k],
           survival = design$survival[k],
           column = design$column[k])
})) |>
  mutate(
    Method = factor(method_labels[method], levels = method_labels),
    column = factor(column, levels = col_order),
    survival = factor(survival, levels = c("Deterministic", "Stochastic"))
  )
```

## Table of models (via Matt)

All models include the same plus group (age 7+). With deterministic survival,
numbers at ages 2+ follow the survival equation; with stochastic survival,
ages 2+ get REs with an estimated process-error SD.

```{r table-design}
design_table <- data.frame(
  Survival = c("Deterministic, plus group", "Stochastic, plus group"),
  `MA innovations` = c("dense", "sparse"),
  `MA states` = c("dense", "dense"),
  `AR states` = c("dense", "sparse"),
  `AR innovations` = c("dense", "dense"),
  check.names = FALSE
)
kable(design_table,
  caption = "Hessian of the random effects for each model. With stochastic survival, the sparsity refers to the recruitment block.",
  align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c")
)
```

## Overview

```{r overview-fn}
## one value per model, laid out as the design table
grid_table <- function(df, value_fn, method) {
  df |>
    filter(method == !!method) |>
    group_by(survival, column) |>
    summarise(value = value_fn(pick(everything())), .groups = "drop") |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = column, values_from = value) |>
    select(Survival = survival, any_of(col_order))
}
n_conv <- function(d) as.character(sum(d$max_rhat < 1.15, na.rm = TRUE))
med_ess <- function(d) sprintf("%.0f", median(d$mean_neff, na.rm = TRUE))
med_min_ess <- function(d) sprintf("%.1f", median(d$min_neff, na.rm = TRUE))
med_time <- function(d) {
  t <- d$time_s[is.finite(d$time_s)]
  if (length(t) == 0) "-" else sprintf("%.2f", median(t))
}
```

```{r table-conv-stan}
kable(grid_table(results, n_conv, "stan"),
  caption = "Stan: replicates (of 100) with all Rhat < 1.15.", align = c("l", rep("r", 4)))
```

```{r table-conv-tmbstan}
kable(grid_table(results, n_conv, "tmbstan"),
  caption = "tmbstan: replicates (of 100) with all Rhat < 1.15.", align = c("l", rep("r", 4)))
```

```{r table-ess-stan}
kable(grid_table(results, med_ess, "stan"),
  caption = "Stan: median (across replicates) of the mean ESS.", align = c("l", rep("r", 4)))
```

```{r table-ess-tmbstan}
kable(grid_table(results, med_ess, "tmbstan"),
  caption = "tmbstan: median (across replicates) of the mean ESS.", align = c("l", rep("r", 4)))
```

```{r table-time-rtmb}
kable(grid_table(results, med_time, "tmb"),
  caption = "RTMB: median optimisation time (s).", align = c("l", rep("r", 4)))
```

```{r summary-fn}
## Summarise key metrics across replicates: mean (SD), as in paper_draft.Rmd
fmt_mean_sd <- function(x) {
  x <- x[is.finite(x)]
  if (length(x) == 0) return("-")
  if (length(x) == 1) return(sprintf("%.2f", x))
  sprintf("%.2f (%.2f)", mean(x), sd(x))
}

make_summary_table <- function(df) {
  metrics <- c("time_s", "mean_neff", "min_neff", "pars_hi_rhat")
  labels <- c("Time (s)", "Mean ESS", "Min ESS", "N pars Rhat > 1.15")

  out <- data.frame(Metric = c(labels, "All Rhat < 1.15"))
  for (tp in levels(df$Method)) {
    sub <- df[df$Method == tp, ]
    if (nrow(sub) == 0) next
    is_mcmc <- tp != "RTMB"
    col <- sapply(metrics, function(m) {
      ## RTMB: time only; MCMC: everything but time (MCMC times not shown for now)
      if (!is_mcmc && m != "time_s") "-"
      else if (is_mcmc && m == "time_s") "-"
      else fmt_mean_sd(sub[[m]])
    })
    out[[tp]] <- c(
      col,
      if (is_mcmc) as.character(sum(sub$max_rhat < 1.15, na.rm = TRUE)) else "-"
    )
  }
  out
}

model_table <- function(proc, re, surv) {
  df <- filter(results, process == proc, random_effect == re, survival == surv)
  kable(make_summary_table(df),
    caption = sprintf("%s, %s as random effects, %s survival with plus group. Mean (SD) across %d replicates.",
                      proc, re, tolower(surv), length(unique(df$i))),
    align = c("l", "r", "r", "r")
  )
}
```
